claims.content: To enable the Business Owner to analyze auction business performance by generating reports on inventory aging, customer rankings, and RFM metrics.

goal.raw_text: To enable the Business Owner to analyze auction business performance by generating reports on inventory aging, customer rankings, and RFM metrics.

claims.content: Business Owner
The Business Owner must be authenticated and logged into the Auction Administration system.
The Business Owner must have access to the 'Auction Administration' module or section of the application.
Historical auction, inventory, customer, and sales data must exist in the system database to populate the reports.

The Business Owner initiates the use case by navigating to a specific report page within the Auction Administration system, such as 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report', 'Customer Ranking Report', or 'Competition Report'.

trigger.raw_text: The Business Owner initiates the use case by navigating to a specific report page within the Auction Administration system, such as 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report', 'Customer Ranking Report', or 'Competition Report'.

claims.content: The Business Owner navigates from the 'Auction Admin Main Menu Page' to a specific report page, such as the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report', 'Customer Ranking Report', or 'Competition Report'.

If viewing the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report', the system displays inventory items with columns for SKU, Last Seen Date, Open PO, Product Type, Brand, Material Type, and Auction Available status.

If viewing the 'Customer Ranking Report', the system displays a list of customers with metrics including Email Address, Total Items Bid On, Gross Items Won, Cancelled Orders, Return Rate, and Net Kept Units.

The Business Owner utilizes filter options to refine the data, such as selecting 'Retail Category', 'Prod_Type', 'Material_Type', or 'Brand' in the Inventory report, or 'Order Date' and 'Retail Category' in the Customer Ranking report.
The Business Owner reviews the generated data to analyze performance indicators like 'Auction Available extended cost', 'Return Rate (%)', or 'Cancel Order Value'.
The Business Owner selects the 'Competition Report' to analyze auction performance metrics such as Gross Product Sales, Total Bids, and Churn Rate by Retail Category.
The Business Owner filters the Competition Report data by selecting specific Order Dates (Start Date/End Date) or Auction Lengths (e.g., 7 Day, 3 Day).
The Business Owner views the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' to see SKU counts, available piece counts, and extended costs for items with no location or unavailable status.
The Business Owner groups inventory data in the Aging Report by fields such as 'Retail_Category', 'Prod_Type', 'Gemstone', or 'Material_Purity'.
If the system encounters an error while retrieving data for a report (e.g., 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' or 'Customer Ranking Report'), it displays an error message to the Business Owner.
The Business Owner cancels the report generation process if the selected filters result in no matching data or if the query times out.
The Business Owner has reviewed the Inventory Performance & Aging Report, including summary statistics such as SKU Count and Auction Available extended cost.
The Business Owner has analyzed customer performance metrics via the Customer Ranking Report, specifically viewing data on Cancelled Orders, Return Rate, and Net Kept Units.
The Business Owner has evaluated auction competition metrics through the Competition Report, observing Gross Product Sales, Total Bids, and Churn Rate by Retail Category.
